title: HELIX Terminology: Honor/Award Type
description: Categories of honors, awards, and distinctions received by students. Used by AwardHonor. Many of these are directory information under 34 CFR 99.3.

codes.definition: Cum laude, magna cum laude, or summa cum laude designation
Term-based academic recognition by a college/school
Term-based academic recognition at the institutional level (typically highest GPA tier)
Award granted by an academic department
Award granted at the institutional level
Nationally recognized award or honor (e.g., Fulbright, Goldwater)
A scholarship awarded to the student
A fellowship awarded to the student
Honor conferred at graduation (e.g., honors program completion)
Induction into an honor society (e.g., Phi Beta Kappa)
